answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Bridge setter brass mark mounted on the frame shop is that proof: each brass is a measured lens yield plus an optician's signature. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 18910 POA and 10980 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Take away the ripple and the name falls away; take away the whisper and the stake falls away; take away the quill and the whole past falls away. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own.
